headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 15 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at $49.3 billion, followed by Base and Solana. Uniswap V3 and V4 dominate DEX volumes with over $1.5 billion each in 24-hour trading. USDT and USDC remain the largest stablecoins by circulation, though several smaller pegs show deviations. Multiple DeFi incidents occurred in the prior fortnight, primarily involving accounting and access control issues.

sections.title: Chains & TVL
bullets: Ethereum holds top position at $49.3 billion TVL.
Base ranks second at $6.0 billion, Solana third at $5.9 billion.
Tron and BSC follow at $5.5 billion and $5.3 billion respectively.

sections.title: DEX & fees
bullets: Uniswap V3 recorded $1.68 billion 24-hour volume, up 10.16 percent.
Uniswap V4 followed at $1.53 billion, up 21.32 percent.
Tether led fees at $17.6 million for the day.

sections.title: Stablecoins
bullets: USDT circulation stands at $183.7 billion across multiple chains.
USDC follows at $72.8 billion, with minor daily contraction.
USDS, USDe and DAI each exceed $4.7 billion in supply.

sections.title: L2s
bullets: Base leads L2 TVS at $15.1 billion with OP Stack.
Hyperliquid reports $6.8 billion TVS as a layer-3 exchange.

sections.title: Security
bullets: Eight incidents reported in the last 14 days, totalling over $5.7 million.
Falcon USD, apxUSD and Frax show peg deviations above 0.5 percent.
pmUSD recorded a 33.86 percent depeg with $62 million circulating.
